title: Be accredited to operate a bus service
what: Be accredited before operating a regular route, or tour and charter, bus service.

sources.title: Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) Act 2001 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 20(1) (current republication (R39, from 5 January 2026; Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) Act 2001 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not operate, in or partly in the ACT, a regular route service unless the person is accredited under the regulations to operate regular route services.

sources.title: Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) Act 2001 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 20(2) (current republication (R39, from 5 January 2026; Road Transport (Public Passenger Services) Act 2001 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not operate, in or partly in the ACT, a tour and charter service unless the person is accredited under the regulations to operate tour and charter services.
